//SECURITY-PATCH: P0 anonymous-spam mitigation (2026-06-06). (1) /stickers/$id: anonymous create still allowed (core anon UX in index.html ~L4261 map-click), but .validate now requires ts within [now-5min, now+1min] AND lat/lng inside venue bbox [35.125..35.150, 126.915..126.970] — caps spam to roughly the venue area and prevents replay of stale/future ts. Client has its own dedupe (STICKER_MIN_INTERVAL/DIST/QUOTA) but those are advisory; the bbox+ts validate is enforced server-side. (2) /stats/{date}/sessions/{$sid}: anonymous writes REMOVED — now requires driver/admin auth. Client at index.html ~L625 PUTs anonymously per session, so anonymous session analytics will silently 401/403 from now on (client logs warn + backoffs, no user-visible UX break since stats is fire-and-forget). MANUAL CONSOLE: deploy via Firebase Console > Realtime Database > Rules (or `firebase deploy --only database`). After deploy verify (a) a fresh sticker tap from the festival venue still saves; (b) anonymous /stats PUT returns 401; (c) driver/admin login still flushes stats OK.

$id..validate: newData.hasChildren(['lat','lng','kind','ts']) && newData.child('lat').isNumber() && newData.child('lng').isNumber() && newData.child('ts').isNumber() && newData.child('kind').isString() && newData.child('kind').val().length <= 16 && (!newData.hasChild('label') || (newData.child('label').isString() && newData.child('label').val().length <= 60)) && newData.child('lat').val() >= 35.125 && newData.child('lat').val() <= 35.150 && newData.child('lng').val() >= 126.915 && newData.child('lng').val() <= 126.970 && newData.child('ts').val() <= (now + 60000) && newData.child('ts').val() >= (now - 300000)

$flushTs..validate: $flushTs.matches(/^[0-9]+$/) && newData.hasChildren(['ts','ev']) && newData.child('ts').isNumber() && newData.child('ev').hasChildren() && (!newData.hasChild('cat') || (newData.child('cat').isString() && newData.child('cat').val().length <= 32)) && (!newData.hasChild('startedAt') || newData.child('startedAt').isNumber()) && (!newData.hasChild('durMs') || newData.child('durMs').isNumber())
